mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MSG_KEY AS msgid, CASE WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALT' THEN 'AT' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'ALI' THEN 'AI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'FRT' THEN 'FT' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'FRI' THEN 'FI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'FRW' THEN 'FI' WHEN MSG_TYPE = 'BRI' THEN 'BM' WHEN MSG_TYPE IN ('SMS','LMS','MMS') THEN 'PH' ELSE MSG_TYPE END AS messagetype, MESSAGE AS msg, MESSAGE AS msgsms, 'P' AS pcom, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, CALL_TO AS phn, CALL_FROM AS smssender, TO_CHAR(RES_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS reservedt, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdt, SENDER_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATE_CODE AS tmplid, WIDE AS wide, BUTTON AS button, FILE_NAME1 AS filepath1, FILE_NAME2 AS filepath2, FILE_NAME3 AS filepath3 FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MSG_STATE = '1' AND ( RES_DATE IS NULL OR RES_DATE <= SYSDATE )
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('ALT', 'ALI')
AND MSG_TYPE IN ('FRT', 'FRI', 'FRW')
AND MSG_TYPE = 'SMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'LMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'MMS'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'BRI'
ORDER BY MSG_KEY ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{logTable})
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${logTable} AS SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2
